{{Quote|He looks like a Jedi.''"<br />"''He was. His name was Ord Enisence.|Cato Parasitti and Cad Bane, on Ord Enisence's dead body|audio=OrdEnisence.flac|<ref name="Heist" />}}
'''Ord Enisence''' was a [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agriworld-2079/Legends|Agriworld-2079]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Enisence was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] while fighting the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] far away from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He was later [[Changeling/Legends|impersonated]] by the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]], who assisted Bane in [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stealing]] a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant.

==Biography==
[[File:OrdEnisenceCorpse.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ord Enisence's body after being killed.]]
Ord Enisence, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agriworld-2079/Legends|Agriworld-2079]],<ref name="TCW Encyclopedia" /> was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Holocron Heist book">''[[The Clone Wars: The Holocron Heist]]''</ref> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the conflict, he was considered to be rather old<ref name="TCW Encyclopedia" /> and hulking.<ref name="EpGuide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he was targeted by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who had the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]<ref name="Bane: Jedi Hunter">{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/jedi_hunter/index.html|text=Cad Bane: Jedi Hunter|int=Cad Bane: Jedi Hunter}}</ref> [[Death/Legends|kill]] Enisence<ref name="EpGuide" /> while he was fighting against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] far from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TCW Encyclopedia" />

[[File:Skrilling_jedi_changeling.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The bounty hunter Cato Parasitti disguised as Enisence in order to infiltrate the Temple Archives.]]
His dead body was subsequently brought to Coruscant and fell into the possession of Bane, who hoped to use it in his plot to [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|steal]] a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]], a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifter]] hired by Bane, assumed Enisence's appearance and infiltrated the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Temple's [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] to provide Bane with inside information. Although Parasitti was ultimately captured, Bane was able to escape with the holocron.<ref name="Holocron Heist book" />

==Personality and traits==
As a Skrilling, Ord Enisence had the common skin color, [[Color/Legends|green]], and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Enisence wore a rust-colored red and tan tunic which contained a collar, and the same colored boots.<ref name="TCW Encyclopedia" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a Skrilling, Ord Enisence had powerful fingers with a crushing grip. He was proficient with both [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]<ref name="TCW Encyclopedia" /> and possessed enough skill to become a Jedi Master.<ref name="Holocron Heist book" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ord Enisence was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and appeared, although only as a corpse, in "[[Holocron Heist]],"<ref name="Heist" /> the first episode of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], which first aired on [[Cartoon Network]] on [[October 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="EpGuide201">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode201.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist}}</ref> His first appearance, however, was in [[The Clone Wars: The Holocron Heist|''The Holocron Heist'']], a young readers book based on the episode and written by [[Rob Valois]].<ref name="Holocron Heist book" />

In the episode, Enisence&mdash;or rather Parasitti impersonating Enisence&mdash;was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voices all of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the series. The episode guide refers to Enisence as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]];<ref name="EpGuide201" /> however, ''The Holocron Heist'' book calls him a Jedi Master. Enisence was inspired by the design of [[Pote Snitkin/Legends|Pote Snitkin]], a Skrilling character who had originated in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Complete Season Two">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|featurette=[[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]]|nolink=1}}</ref>

According to concept art by [[Kilian Plunkett]], early candidates for Enisence's [[Species/Legends|species]] included him being a Human, among other options.<ref name="Art of SW:TCW booklet">{{StoryCite|story=The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars (booklet)|book=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition|bformatted=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition|sformatted=''The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars''|smanual=1}}</ref>
